notes: PARTS THAT SHARE ONE MODEL (THE MICRO RELAYS, LUGS, JUMPER WIRES) ARE BALLOONED ON THE FIRST ITEM OF THEIR GROUP.
USE THE M5 x 10 FEED BOLT, NOT A SHORTER ONE: ITS TIP GOES 1.7 INTO THE SPINE AND LOCKS THE STRIP.
SHEET 2: WHAT EACH FUSE AND RELAY FEEDS. SHEETS 3 AND 4: THE HARNESS WIRE AT EACH TERMINAL, NAMED AS ON THE HARNESS DRAWINGS.
TERMINALS GO IN FROM UNDER THE DECK, CONTACT BOX FIRST, UNTIL THE LANCE CLICKS. PULL THE WIRE BACK GENTLY TO CHECK IT HOLDS (TE 114-2025 3.6, 114-20021 3.7).
KEEP HARNESS TIES AT LEAST 38 mm BELOW THE DECK, AND DO NOT BEND THE WIRES HARD TO ONE SIDE AT THE DECK (TE 114-20021 3.7 C).
